a036afe62b00: An account order ID connects your purchase instruction to messages and seller actions. A warehouse item ID connects a received item to storage and later parcel selection. f5a8e4abbfbf: Create columns for identifier type, value, issuing system, related parent record and current stage. Never overwrite an order ID with a tracking number.
